title: review
description: Use when a change needs an independent read-only review: static mode judges tier and fidelity-gap validity, teeth, and structure coupling (G9, R3, R4, G12) and correctness, returning findings by severity with file:line evidence; blind mode accepts only the word Review and a diff (inline, by file path, or as one git range plus a repo path) (at Deep rigor also the specification and tests, never the implementer's reasoning). Has no edit or write tools; Bash only for read-only git diff. Triggers: "review this diff", "static review", "blind review", "is this test valid".
author: sox-ecosystem

invocation.description: Declarative agent — host reads the prose body and renders the host header from agent/render at install time.

agent.name: review
agent.description: Read-only reviewer with static and blind modes. Returns findings by severity with file:line evidence; blind mode accepts only the word Review and a diff (inline, by file path, or one git range plus a repo path). Cannot edit or write; Bash only for read-only git diff.
